name: form-item
description: Layout wrapper pairing a form field with its label and helper text.

anatomy.name: field-label
anatomy.description: Text label that names the field, placed above or beside it.

anatomy.name: necessity-indicator
anatomy.description: Mark or text after the label that shows the field is required or optional.

anatomy.name: help-text
anatomy.description: Description or error message shown below the field.

anatomyReview.notes: Figma S2 Web Field label page (label only) plus the relationship context for spacing between label, field and help text. The field itself is another component, not a part.
